title: Marquee Crossing Window Selection
description: Restore canonical drag-direction marquee selection (left-to-right = window/total inclusion, right-to-left = crossing/partial inclusion) for 3D world WGPU renderer.
summary: Fixed face hover and rectangle selection preview regression. Face cursor pick now uses ray_pick_mesh_detail (mesh raycast) with logical face ids. Hover state is preserved when selection JSON omits hoveredComponent until the plugin explicitly clears it. Face overlays activate for selection_targets.face as well as granularity face. Marquee face selection no longer requires non-empty face_ids. setSelection updates local component_ids immediately after rectangle commit. Added tests for face marquee preview, hover preservation, and overlays. infinite_world 25/25 tests pass.
